evidence: VR/05-resonant-tank-envelope/round6-full-power/outputs/board-side-protection.csv (cap_part_over_TDK85C_max: 0.887 at 22 A, 1.117 at 28 A); PS/DECISIONS.md:519 ('at 28 A the bank is 1.12x TDK 85 C curve'), :455-458 (C5/C6 9 uF); VR/08-manufacturing-package/native-21/sourcing/alt-circuits-2026-10-09/ALT-C5C6.md:126-131 (C5/C6 ripple dT 7.8 K vs 9.8 K allowed at 85 C ambient = 80 % at 22 A); VR/04-board-current-thermal/round5-native21/b3-convergence/README.md:70-71 (bank 15.3 K margin, HF caps C38-C41 5.0 K margin to 105 C, 'class values assumed'); PS/DECISIONS.md:155 (10 uF X7R DC-bias loss 'not credited'); cmd: python3 -I PS/validation-results/09-rubric-review-s19b/scripts/aoe_02_c5c6_scaling.py -> 12.6 K at 28 A
note: Mechanism: film-cap ripple self-heating. Losses of bank/HF caps are modelled only as a board share. No measurement. This is a plausible unclosed margin at the stated 28 A hardware envelope (fine at the 22 A shipping ceiling).  Action: Keep commissioned ceiling at 22 A until bench hot-spot IR on the middle bank cap, C38-C41 and C5/C6 at 28 A (DECISIONS.md:519 gate); add airflow over bank or relocate/derate HF caps; get TDK ESR(100 kHz) for B32676.
